name: appshell-url-session-race
title: Fix AppShell URL session restore race
description: A reload of ?session=<id> can land on the project's remembered last-open session instead: handleCwdChange's restore path runs before the URL session is resolved and rewrite the URL to the stale session, making e2e/chat-appearance.mjs:76 flaky (5 of the last 7 personal runs).
creator: xupeng
